# Step - all

`all` · category: [Filters](../../traversal/step_reference.md#filters)

Keeps a list whose every element matches the predicate (an empty list matches).

## Forms

```text
all(arg1: any)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject([1, 2, 3]).all(P.gt(0)).next()   // [1, 2, 3]
```
